description: Generic golden questions for grounded repo-memory evals. Top-level defaults inherit to every question; /learn-repos populates revision, fingerprint, and tag values at runtime.

freshness_required_tags.populated_at: runtime from indexed repo HEAD and computed source-document fingerprint

authoritative_search.query_requirement: non-empty semantic string derived from the question

questions.question: What is the primary runtime and entrypoint for the example service?
questions.pass_criteria: Names runtime and entrypoint with source_paths citation from freshness-passing memory

questions.question: How do requests flow through the example service's main components?
questions.pass_criteria: Describes data/control flow with at least one architecture doc path cited

questions.question: What external systems does the widget plugin integrate with?
questions.pass_criteria: Lists integrations grounded in ARCHITECTURE or README sources

questions.question: Where is configuration loaded and what environment dimensions exist?
questions.pass_criteria: Explains config sources without inventing env vars absent from docs

questions.question: What are the published package boundaries and what must consumers not import?
questions.pass_criteria: States boundaries from AGENTS or CONTRIBUTING with citation

questions.question: How does state management or persistence work in the shared library?
questions.pass_criteria: Architecture answer from indexed dossier; rejects stale revision candidates

questions.question: Which environments does the deployment repo target and how are they separated?
questions.pass_criteria: Environment model cited from runbooks or ARCHITECTURE

questions.question: What command installs dependencies and which Node or runtime version is required?
questions.pass_criteria: Procedure memory preferred; cites README or AGENTS install section

questions.question: How do you run the unit test suite locally before committing?
questions.pass_criteria: Ordered steps from repo-procedure with verification step

questions.question: What is the release or publish workflow for the widget plugin?
questions.pass_criteria: Release procedure with prerequisites and failure modes when documented

questions.question: How do you serve or run the plugin locally for development?
questions.pass_criteria: Dev-server steps from procedure; freshness tags match current HEAD fingerprint

questions.question: What lint and typecheck commands must pass before a PR?
questions.pass_criteria: CI/local gate commands cited from CONTRIBUTING or AGENTS

questions.question: How is a change promoted from preview to production?
questions.pass_criteria: Promotion procedure with verification checkpoints

questions.question: What secrets or credential tooling does deployment use and where must secrets never be stored?
questions.pass_criteria: Operational guidance without storing secret values in memory

questions.question: What should you check when the local dev server fails to start?
questions.pass_criteria: Failure-mode procedure; dead-end triggers doc re-read if no fresh memory

questions.question: How do you diagnose failing CI checks for this repository?
questions.pass_criteria: Troubleshooting steps with source citation; no stale-revision fallback

questions.question: What are known pre-existing test or type failures called out in repo docs?
questions.pass_criteria: Quotes documented known issues; rejects invented failures

questions.question: What doctor or health command validates the local toolchain for this plugin?
questions.pass_criteria: Verification command from runbook; mandatory source_paths in answer

questions.question: What should you do when package version or lockfile conflicts block install?
questions.pass_criteria: Recovery procedure; quality score cannot accept stale fingerprint

questions.question: How do you roll back a bad deployment according to repo runbooks?
questions.pass_criteria: Rollback steps with cross-repo isolation — answer scoped to ops/deployment-repo only
